assurance: Complete classification of the stated full-braid family, with component completeness explicitly imported from the published primary paper. Monodromy, permutation labels and exact sizes have internal written derivations and bounded exact controls. The arbitrary-passport goal remains open. No independent replay, formal verification, external review or priority claim for these derivations.

declarations.name: Theorem B1. Complete imported component labels
declarations.scope: For N,A,B,s with s>=1,2<=B<=A<=floor(N/2),A+B+s=N-1, all full braid components of passport(2^A1^(N-2A)),(2^B1^(N-2B)),T^s have exactly the labels of published Bogatyrev-Gendron Theorem1.2 and Corollary2. If both fixed counts are positive: one per n|N with N/n odd and n>=N-2B. If one fixed count is zero: one per n|N with N/n even and admissible unordered positive partition e+f=2s+2, e,f<=n, same parity as n. This is an explicitly imported completeness theorem.

declarations.name: Theorem B2. Monodromy, every block system and deck symmetry
declarations.scope: For every tuple in this family, its literal monodromy is the same standard S_n wr Delta_m, N=nm, where n is the least Pell degree and Delta_m is the natural Chebyshev group (trivial/C2/dihedral). All block-count divisors are exactly divisors(m) union {N}. Normal transposition-support components are the finest proper blocks; the deck group is trivial for n>=3 and diagonalC2 for n2. Pell and permutation primitivity agree in this family, using the Chebyshev quotient and square-free-part identity.

declarations.name: Theorem B3. Reading the complete component label from permutations
declarations.scope: A complete component label is computable directly from the literal permutations: normal transposition supports determine n,m; for odd m no extra label is required, while for even m the two fixed quotient slots of the smaller bundled factor give e,f from the fixed-point counts of its return involutions. This reads the imported partition invariant without a polynomial equation.

declarations.name: Lemma B4. An exact ordered class count
declarations.scope: For a,b>=0,a,b<=floor(n/2),s>=1,a+b+s=n-1, the exact ordered product-P_n count is n^(s+1)(n-a-1)!(n-b-1)!/[a!b!(n-2a)!(n-2b)!], including identity heavy entries. A self-contained hook-character/Krawtchouk evaluation proves this, retaining rational factors exactly.

declarations.name: Theorem B5. Exact literal and absolute component sizes
declarations.scope: For every admissible component label, a finite Mobius sum over odd divisors gives its primitive ordered inner count. Multiplication by the exact quotient-pair, attachment and type-placement counts gives all literal orbit sizes in equations13-14. Dividing by N, with deck factor2 only for n2, gives all absolute sizes. No unproved primitive connectivity or generic relabeling division enters the count.

declarations.name: Corollary B6. Primitive connectivity and a same-group infinite family
declarations.scope: In every such passport with both bundled fixed counts positive, exactly one component is primitive Sn; if one bundled involution is fixed-point-free none is primitive. For every odd prime p>=5, degree2p passport(2^p),(2^(p-3)1^6),T,T has exactly two components with the same standard S_p wr C2, block divisors1,2,2p and trivial deck group, labelled1+5 and3+3. Their literal sizes are p^3(p^2-9)(p^2-1)/20 and p^3(p^2-1)^2/12. The new partition label is not identified with a reduced Schur or spin invariant.

mathematical_review.scope: Internal audit of published-version theorem numbering and hypotheses, full/absolute braid conventions, least Pell degree versus permutation primitivity, finest transposition blocks, small dihedral degrees, complete literal partition extraction, Krawtchouk character sum including identity positions, exact divisor exclusion and even-m assignment factor, deck correction, prime-family completeness and separation from reduced-spin claims.

remaining_frontier: General primitive Sn/An passports, remaining restricted return actions outside the now classified involution/simple and prior cyclic/small-fibre families, and reduced lifting classification remain open. Pure or individually marked braid components are not asserted by B1-B6.
